reviews.x: As weird as it sounds, I'm a bit of a tweezer snob. I've had many tweezers over the years, cheap and not cheap, and most just do not work that well. They either can't grip the hair at all, or they can't hold well enough to pull out a stubborn hair.  These are my favorite tweezers ever. I always use the number 9. It grips hair and pulls it out, usually on the first try. After I used mine for a few weeks, I bought another set for my mom. Just love these!

reviews.x: I am a sucker for beauty implements and I love, love, love this set of tweezers! claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the tweezers' grip and precision, saying they pull stubborn or hard-to-reach hairs that other tweezers miss.
Many reviewers consider this the best tweezer set they have owned, often comparing it favorably to pricier or well-known brands.
Reviewers appreciate the multi-piece set with different tweezer options for different needs, plus the included case or pouch for keeping them organized.
Several reviewers find the set a good value for the price, especially given the quality and number of pieces.
A few reviewers report the tweezers are cheap, bulky, and fail to grip hairs at all, calling them a waste of money.
